title: Influenza arm fit targets
description: The scored observables of the influenza arm, one row per anchor, plus the confined-SAR floor constants the readouts bound against. Nothing here is a model parameter: a row is a quantity an observer of the real event held or a sourced dose-response interval. Unlike the covid file this arm carries no train/test split — it has too few anchors to spend one.

scorable.description: Absent means scorable; false declares that no instrument in the observation model measures this quantity.

confined_sar_floor.description: The dose-derived confined-SAR floor band: E[1-exp(-k*D_slot)] over the cell's pooled slot doses at the declared k sourced interval (docs/confined_attack_floor_spec.md).
